intro.en: A boy comes home carrying many prizes and talks with his grandmother and grandfather. Notice how he stays humble and thanks them with the du'a «جَزاكُمَا اللهُ خَيْراً».
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek bacha bahut se inaamaat le kar ghar aata hai aur dadi dada se baat karta hai. Dhyan dein ke woh kitna aajiz hai aur dua «جَزاكُمَا اللهُ خَيْراً» se unka shukriya ada karta hai.
intro.ar: وَلَدٌ يَعودُ إِلى البَيْتِ وَمَعَهُ جَوائِزُ كَثيرَةٌ وَيَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ جَدَّتِهِ وَجَدِّهِ. اِنْتَبِهْ كَيْفَ يَتَواضَعُ وَيَشْكُرُهُما بِدُعاءِ «جَزاكُمَا اللهُ خَيْراً».

dialogue.ar: ماذا في يَدَيْكَ يا ياسِرُ؟ تَكادُ الأَغْراضُ تَقَعُ مِنْكَ!
dialogue.tr: mādhā fī yadayka yā yāsir? takādu l-aghrāḍu taqaʿu mink
dialogue.en: What is in your hands, Yasir? The things are almost falling from you!
dialogue.ur: Yasir, tumhare haathon mein kya hai? Saaman gira hi chahta hai!

dialogue.ar: إِنَّها جَوائِزُ يا جَدَّتي. ساعِدوني مِنْ فَضْلِكُمْ، فَهِيَ كَثيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: innahā jawʾizu yā jaddatī sāʿidūnī min faḍlikum, fahiya kathīra
dialogue.en: They are prizes, grandmother. Please help me, there are many of them.
dialogue.ur: Dadi jaan, ye inaamaat hain. Meherbani karke meri madad karein, ye bohat zyada hain.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَيْنَ جِئْتَ بِهَذِهِ الجَوائِزِ كُلِّها؟ وَما المُسابَقَةُ الَّتي فُزْتَ فيها؟
dialogue.tr: min ayna jiʾta bihadhihi l-jawʾizi kullihā? wamā l-musābaqatu llatī fuzta fīhā?
dialogue.en: Where did you bring all these prizes from? And which competition did you win?
dialogue.ur: Ye saare inaamaat kahan se laye ho? Aur tumne kaun sa muqabla jeeta?

dialogue.ar: نِلْتُها في الحَفْلِ الخِتامِيِّ لِمَدْرَسَتي؛ فَجائِزَةُ الخَطابَةِ لي، وَكَذَلِكَ جائِزَةُ السّيرَةِ النَّبَوِيَّةِ، وَجائِزَةُ حِفْظِ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ.
dialogue.tr: niltuhā fī l-ḥafli l-khitāmiyyi limadrasatī fajāʾizatu l-khaṭābati lī, wakadhalika jāʾizatu s-sīrati n-nabawiya, wajāʾizatu ḥifẓi l-qurʾāni l-karīm
dialogue.en: I got them at my school's closing ceremony; the public speaking prize is mine, and also the Prophet's biography prize and the prize for memorising the Holy Quran.
dialogue.ur: Ye mujhe apne school ki ikhtitami taqreeb mein mile; khitabat ka inaam mera hai, aur Seerat-e-Nabawi ka inaam bhi, aur Quran-e-Kareem hifz karne ka inaam bhi.

dialogue.ar: ما شاءَ اللهُ! حَفِظَ حَفيدي القُرْآنَ وَتَعَلَّمَ السّيرَةَ أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: mā shāʾa llāh ḥafiẓa ḥafīdī l-qurʾāna wataʿallama s-sīrata ayḍan
dialogue.en: Masha Allah! My grandson memorised the Quran and learned the biography as well.
dialogue.ur: Masha Allah! Mere pote ne Quran hifz kiya aur seerat bhi seekhi.

dialogue.ar: كانَتِ المُنافَسَةُ قَوِيَّةً جِدّاً، فَقَدْ شارَكَ في المُسابَقَةِ مِئاتُ الطُّلّابِ.
dialogue.tr: kānati l-munāfasatu qawiyyatan jiddan, faqad shāraka fī l-musābaqati miʾātu ṭ-ṭulāb
dialogue.en: The competition was very strong; hundreds of students took part in it.
dialogue.ur: Muqabla bohat sakht tha, kyunke sainkron talba ne is mein hissa liya.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا عَنْ صَديقِكَ نَديمٍ؟ هَلْ حَصَلَ عَلى جائِزَةٍ؟
dialogue.tr: wamādhā ʿan ṣadīqika nadīm? hal ḥaṣala ʿalā jāʾiza?
dialogue.en: And what about your friend Nadeem? Did he get a prize?
dialogue.ur: Aur tumhare dost Nadeem ka kya hua? Kya use koi inaam mila?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، فازَ نَديمٌ بِجائِزَتَيْنِ: الرِّياضِيّاتِ وَالرَّسْمِ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, fāza nadīmun bijāʾizatayn ar-rīḍiyāti war-rasm
dialogue.en: Yes, Nadeem won two prizes: mathematics and drawing.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, Nadeem ne do inaam jeete: riyazi aur drawing.

dialogue.ar: ما أَجْمَلَ هَذا اليَوْمَ! قَلْبي مَمْلوءٌ بِالفَرَحِ.
dialogue.tr: mā ajmala hādhā l-yawm qalbī mamlūʾun bil-faraḥ
dialogue.en: How beautiful this day is! My heart is full of joy.
dialogue.ur: Kitna khoobsurat din hai! Mera dil khushi se bhara hua hai.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَنا يا بُنَيَّ بِاجْتِهادِكَ.
dialogue.tr: laqad rafaʿta raʾsanā yā bunayya bijtihādik
dialogue.en: You have made us proud, my boy, with your hard work.
dialogue.ur: Beta, tumne apni mehnat se hamara sar uncha kar diya.

dialogue.ar: لَوْلا دُعاؤُكُما وَتَشْجيعُكُما ما نَجَحْتُ. جَزاكُمَا اللهُ خَيْراً.
dialogue.tr: lawlā duʿāʾukumā watashjīʿukumā mā najaḥt jazākumā llāh khayran
dialogue.en: Without your prayers and encouragement I would not have succeeded. May Allah reward you both with good.
dialogue.ur: Aap dono ki duaon aur hausla afzai ke baghair main kamyab na hota. Allah aap dono ko jazaa-e-khair de.

dialogue.ar: وَنَحْنُ سَنُعْطيكَ هَدِيَّةً مِنّا، فَاطْلُبْ ما تُريدُ.
dialogue.tr: wanaḥnu sanuʿṭīka hadiyyatan minnā, fāṭlub mā turīd
dialogue.en: And we will give you a gift from us, so ask for whatever you want.
dialogue.ur: Aur hum tumhein apni taraf se tohfa denge, jo chaho maango.

dialogue.ar: لا أُريدُ هَدِيَّةً يا جَدَّتي، فَالحَمْدُ للهِ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، وَلَكِنْ عِنْدي طَلَبٌ آخَرُ.
dialogue.tr: lā urīdu hadiyyatan yā jaddatī, fal-ḥamdu lillāh ʿalā kulli shayʾ, walakin ʿindī ṭalabun ʾākhar
dialogue.en: I do not want a gift, grandmother, as praise be to Allah for everything, but I have another request.
dialogue.ur: Dadi jaan, mujhe tohfa nahin chahiye, har cheez par Allah ka shukr hai, lekin mera ek aur sawal hai.

dialogue.ar: وَما هُوَ يا بُنَيَّ؟ قُلْ، وَسَنَفْعَلُ ما نَسْتَطيعُ.
dialogue.tr: wamā huwa yā bunayy? qul, wasanafʿalu mā nastaṭīʿ
dialogue.en: And what is it, my boy? Say it, and we will do what we can.
dialogue.ur: Wo kya hai beta? Bolo, jo hum se ho sakega hum karenge.

dialogue.ar: أَطْلُبُ مِنْكُما أَنْ تَدْعُوا لي، وَأَنْ تَعْفُوا عَنْ أَخْطائي الصَّغيرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭlubu minkumā an tadʿū lī, waʾan taʿfū ʿan akhṭāʾī ṣ-ṣaghīra
dialogue.en: I ask you both to pray for me and to forgive my small mistakes.
dialogue.ur: Main aap dono se guzarish karta hoon ke mere liye dua karein aur meri chhoti ghaltiyan maaf kar dein.

dialogue.ar: عَفَوْنا عَنْكَ يا حَبيبي، وَوَفَّقَكَ اللهُ في دِراسَتِكَ وَحَياتِكَ.
dialogue.tr: ʿafawnā ʿanka yā ḥabībī, wawaffaqaka llāh fī dirāsatika waḥaytik
dialogue.en: We forgive you, my dear, and may Allah grant you success in your studies and your life.
dialogue.ur: Humne tumhein maaf kiya mere pyare, aur Allah tumhein parhai aur zindagi mein kamyabi de.

dialogue.ar: جَزاكُمَا اللهُ خَيْراً يا جَدّي وَيا جَدَّتي.
dialogue.tr: jazākumā llāh khayran yā jaddī way jaddatī
dialogue.en: May Allah reward you both with good, grandfather and grandmother.
dialogue.ur: Dada jaan aur dadi jaan, Allah aap dono ko jazaa-e-khair de.

vocab.en: may Allah reward you with good
vocab.ur: Allah aapko behtar badla de (jazak Allah)

q.en: What does «جَوائِزُ» mean?
q.ur: «جَوائِزُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which prize did Yasir NOT get himself?
q.ur: Yasir ko kaun sa inaam khud nahin mila?
q.ar: أَيُّ جائِزَةٍ لَمْ يَحْصُلْ عَلَيْها ياسِرٌ؟

q.en: What does Yasir ask his grandparents for?
q.ur: Yasir apne dada dadi se kya maangta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَطْلُبُ ياسِرٌ مِنْ جَدِّهِ وَجَدَّتِهِ؟

q.en: Yasir says his success was, after Allah, thanks to:
q.ur: Yasir kehta hai ke uski kamyabi Allah ke baad kis ki wajah se hai:
q.ar: يَقولُ ياسِرٌ إِنَّ نَجاحَهُ كانَ بَعْدَ اللهِ بِفَضْلِ:

q.en: What is the dua of thanks used in this dialogue?
q.ur: Shukriye ki kaun si dua is mukaalme mein hai?
q.ar: ما دُعاءُ الشُّكْرِ المُسْتَعْمَلُ في هَذا الحِوارِ؟

intro.en: Tanween is a silent letter noon added to the end of a word: two fathas (-ً), two dammas (-ٌ) or two kasras (-ٍ). It is pronounced when you do not stop on the word. Example: كِتابٌ – kitābun.
intro.ur: Tanween ek saakin noon hai jo lafz ke aakhir mein aata hai: do zabar (-ً), do pesh (-ٌ) ya do zer (-ٍ). Yeh us waqt parha jata hai jab lafz par ruka na jaye. Misal: كِتابٌ – kitābun.
intro.ar: التَّنْوينُ نونٌ ساكِنَةٌ تَلْحَقُ آخِرَ الاسْمِ، وَهُوَ ضَمَّتانِ أَوْ فَتْحَتانِ أَوْ كَسْرَتانِ، وَيُنْطَقُ إِذا وَصَلْنا الكَلامَ وَلَمْ نَقِفْ عَلَيْهِ. مِثالٌ: كِتابٌ.

q.en: What is tanween?
q.ur: Tanween kya hai?

options: A silent noon added at the end of a word
A letter at the start of a word

q.en: Which of these has tanween of raf' (two dammas)?
q.ur: In mein se kis par tanween-e-raf' (do pesh) hai?

q.en: Which of these has tanween of nasb (two fathas)?
q.ur: In mein se kis par tanween-e-nasb (do zabar) hai?

q.en: Which word has tanween of jarr (two kasras)?
q.ur: Kis lafz par tanween-e-jarr (do zer) hai?

intro.en: To make the plural of a male person, add «ون» (wa-noon) in the raf' case, or «ين» (ya-noon) in the nasb and jarr cases. Example: مُسْلِمٌ → مُسْلِمونَ (Muslims) and مُسْلِمينَ.
intro.ur: Mard ki jama banane ke liye raf' mein «ون» (waw noon) lagate hain aur nasb o jarr mein «ين» (ya noon). Misal: مُسْلِمٌ → مُسْلِمونَ (musalman, jama) aur مُسْلِمينَ.
intro.ar: نَجْمَعُ المُذَكَّرَ العاقِلَ بِإِضافَةِ «ون» في حالَةِ الرَّفْعِ، وَ«ين» في حالَتَيِ النَّصْبِ وَالجَرِّ. مِثالٌ: مُسْلِمٌ ← مُسْلِمونَ وَمُسْلِمينَ.

q.en: How do you form the sound masculine plural in the raf' case?
q.ur: Raf' mein jam' muzakkar saalim kaise banate hain?
q.ar: كَيْفَ نُكَوِّنُ جَمْعَ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ في حالَةِ الرَّفْعِ؟

q.en: Which ending is used in the nasb and jarr cases?
q.ur: Nasb aur jarr mein kaun si ending aati hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ نِهايَةٍ تُسْتَعْمَلُ في حالَتَيِ النَّصْبِ وَالجَرِّ؟

q.en: What is the plural of «مُسْلِمٌ» in the raf' case?
q.ur: «مُسْلِمٌ» ki raf' mein jama kya hai?

q.en: In «رَأَيْتُ المُصَلّينَ في المَسْجِدِ», why does the plural end with «ين»?
q.ur: «رَأَيْتُ المُصَلّينَ في المَسْجِدِ» mein jama «ين» par kyun khatam hoti hai?
q.ar: في «رَأَيْتُ المُصَلّينَ في المَسْجِدِ» لِماذا انْتَهى الجَمْعُ بِـ«ين»؟

options: It is in the nasb case (object)
It is in the raf' case

intro.en: A reading passage about why countries give prizes, what a prize may include, and the two kinds: local prizes and international prizes. Read each sentence slowly and look at the new words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek parhne ka tukra hai: mulk inaamaat kyun dete hain, inaam ke saath kya milta hai, aur inaamaat ki do qismein: maqami aur aalami. Har jumla aahista parhein aur naye alfaz dekhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنْ سَبَبِ مَنْحِ الدُّوَلِ لِلْجَوائِزِ، وَما قَدْ تَشْمَلُهُ الجائِزَةُ، وَنَوْعَيْها: جَوائِزُ مَحَلِّيَّةٌ وَجَوائِزُ دَوْلِيَّةٌ. اِقْرَأْ كُلَّ جُمْلَةٍ بِبُطْءٍ وَانْتَبِهْ إِلى الكَلِماتِ الجَديدَةِ.

dialogue.ar: تَمْنَحُ الدُّوَلُ وَالمُؤَسَّساتُ جَوائِزَ لِلْمُتَفَوِّقينَ في مَجالاتٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: tamnaḥu d-duwalu wal-muʾassasātu jawʾiza lil-mutafawwiqīna fī majālātin mukhtalifa
dialogue.en: States and institutions give prizes to those who excel in different fields.
dialogue.ur: Mumalik aur idare mukhtalif maidanon mein numaya logon ko inaamaat dete hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلِكُلِّ جائِزَةٍ هَدَفٌ؛ فَبَعْضُها يَخْدِمُ العُلومَ، وَبَعْضُها يَخْدِمُ الأَدَبَ وَالثَّقافَةَ.
dialogue.tr: walikulli jāʾizatin hadaf fabaʿḍuhā yakhdimu l-ʿulūm, wabaʿḍuhā yakhdimu l-adaba wath-thaqāfa
dialogue.en: Every prize has an aim; some serve the sciences and some serve literature and culture.
dialogue.ur: Har inaam ka ek maqsad hota hai; kuch uloom ki khidmat karte hain aur kuch adab o saqafat ki.

dialogue.ar: وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ هَيْئَةٍ شُروطاً لِمَنْ يَنالُ الجائِزَةَ، وَتَخْتارُ لَجْنَةٌ مِنَ العُلَماءِ الفائِزينَ بِها.
dialogue.tr: wataḍaʿu kullu hayʾatin shurūṭan liman yanālu l-jāʾiza, watakhtāru lajnatun mina l-ʿulamāʾi l-fāʾizīna bihā
dialogue.en: Every body sets conditions for whoever receives the prize, and a committee of scholars chooses its winners.
dialogue.ur: Har idara inaam pane walon ke liye shartein rakhta hai, aur ulama ki ek committee unke jeetne walon ko chunti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ تَكونُ الجائِزَةُ مُكافَأَةً مالِيَّةً تَخْتَلِفُ قيمَتُها مِنْ جائِزَةٍ إِلى أُخْرى، وَقَدْ يَبْلُغُ مَبْلَغُها مَبالِغَ كَبيرَةً.
dialogue.tr: waqad takūnu l-jāʾizatu mukāfaʾatan māliyyatan takhtalifu qīmatuhā min jāʾizatin ilā ukhrā, waqad yablughu mablaghuhā mabāligha kabīra
dialogue.en: A prize may be a financial reward whose value differs from one prize to another, and the sum may reach large amounts.
dialogue.ur: Inaam maali inaam ho sakta hai jis ki qeemat ek se doosre mein mukhtalif hoti hai, aur rakam bohat badi bhi ho sakti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيُعْطى الفائِزُ مَعَ المُكافَأَةِ دِرْعاً أَوْ شَهادَةً تَحْمِلُ اسْمَهُ.
dialogue.tr: wayuʿṭā l-fāʾizu maʿa l-mukāfaʾati dirʿan aw shahādatan taḥmilu smah
dialogue.en: Along with the reward the winner is given a shield or a certificate bearing his name.
dialogue.ur: Jeetne wale ko inaami raqam ke saath ek dhaal ya apne naam wali sanad di jati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالجَوائِزُ تَنْقَسِمُ بِحَسَبِ مَنْ يَمْنَحُها إِلى: نَوْعٍ مَحَلِّيٍّ، وَنَوْعٍ عالَمِيٍّ.
dialogue.tr: wal-jawʾizu tanqasimu biḥasabi man yamnaḥuhā ilā nawʿin maḥalliyy, wanawʿin ʿālamiyy
dialogue.en: Prizes are divided, according to who gives them, into a local kind and an international kind.
dialogue.ur: Inaamaat is lihaz se do qisam ke hain ke kaun deta hai: ek maqami aur ek aalmi.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا المَحَلِّيَّةُ فَتُقَدِّمُها الدَّوْلَةُ لِمُواطِنيها الَّذينَ أَفادوا وَطَنَهُمْ بِعِلْمِهِمْ وَعَمَلِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-maḥalliyyatu fatuqaddimuhā d-dawlatu limūṭinīhā lladhīna afādū waṭanahum biʿilmihim waʿamalihim
dialogue.en: As for local prizes, the state gives them to its citizens who benefited their homeland with their knowledge and work.
dialogue.ur: Maqami inaamaat riyasat apne shehriyon ko deti hai jinhon ne apne ilm aur kaam se watan ko faida pahunchaya.

dialogue.ar: وَأَمّا العالَمِيَّةُ فَتُقَدِّمُها هَيْئاتٌ دَوْلِيَّةٌ لِأَشْخاصٍ مِنْ بُلْدانٍ مُخْتَلِفَةٍ خَدَموا الإِنْسانَ في أَيِّ مَكانٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ.
dialogue.tr: waʾammā l-ʿālamiyyatu fatuqaddimuhā hayʾātun dawliyyatun liʾashkhāṣin min buldānin mukhtalifatin khadamū l-insāna fī ayyi makānin mina l-arḍ
dialogue.en: As for international prizes, international bodies give them to people from different countries who served humanity anywhere on earth.
dialogue.ur: Aalmi inaamaat beinul-aqwami idare mukhtalif mulkon ke un logon ko dete hain jinhon ne zameen par kahin bhi insaan ki khidmat ki.

vocab.ur: woh rakhta hai, muqarrar karta hai

q.en: What is the aim of these prizes, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq in inaamaat ka maqsad kya hai?
q.ar: ما هَدَفُ هَذِهِ الجَوائِزِ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Who gives local prizes?
q.ur: Maqami inaamaat kaun deta hai?

options: The state to its own citizens

q.en: Who gives international prizes?
q.ur: Aalami inaamaat kaun deta hai?

q.en: Who chooses the winners of a prize?
q.ur: Inaam ke jeetne walon ko kaun chunta hai?

q.en: A prize is usually a financial reward. What else may come with it?
q.ur: Inaam aam taur par maali hota hai. Iske saath aur kya ho sakta hai?
q.ar: الجائِزَةُ في الغالِبِ مُكافَأَةٌ مالِيَّةٌ. فَماذا يُمْنَحُ مَعَها أَيْضاً؟

intro.en: Feminine is the opposite of masculine. In nouns the signs are: ta' marbuta (فاطِمَةُ), alif maqsura (سَلْمى) and alif mamduda (سَمْراءُ). In verbs: a silent ta' at the end of the past verb (خَرَجَتْ) and a ta' at the start of the present verb (تَخْرُجُ).
intro.ur: Ta'neeth, tazkeer ka ulta hai. Ismon mein alaamaat: ta marbuta (فاطِمَةُ), alif maqsura (سَلْمى) aur alif mamduda (سَمْراءُ). Fe'lon mein: maazi ke aakhir mein saakin ta (خَرَجَتْ) aur mudaare' ke shuru mein ta (تَخْرُجُ).
intro.ar: المُؤَنَّثُ ضِدُّ المُذَكَّرِ. عَلاماتُهُ في الأَسْماءِ: التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ (فاطِمَةُ)، وَالأَلِفُ المَقْصورَةُ (سَلْمى)، وَالأَلِفُ المَمْدودَةُ (سَمْراءُ). وَفي الأَفْعالِ: تاءٌ ساكِنَةٌ في آخِرِ الماضي (خَرَجَتْ)، وَتاءٌ في أَوَّلِ المُضارِعِ (تَخْرُجُ).

q.en: Which word ends with ta' marbuta?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz ta marbuta par khatam hota hai?

q.en: Which word ends with alif maqsura?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz alif maqsura par khatam hota hai?

q.ur: Muannas maazi fe'l, jaise «خَرَجَتْ», ki nishani kya hai?
q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ تَأْنيثِ الفِعْلِ الماضي مِثْلِ «خَرَجَتْ»؟

options: A silent ta' at the end

q.ar: ما عَلامَةُ تَأْنيثِ الفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ مِثْلِ «تَخْرُجُ»؟

options: A silent ta' at the end

intro.en: The school principal and the teachers meet to choose the ideal student. Each teacher names one quality. Note that the prize at the end is books, a bag and some money.
intro.ur: School ke principal aur ustaad misali talib-e-ilm chunne ke liye jama hote hain. Har ustaad ek khoobi bataata hai. Aakhir mein inaam kitabein, ek bag aur kuch raqam hai.
intro.ar: يَجْتَمِعُ مُديرُ المَدْرَسَةِ وَالمُعَلِّمونَ لِاخْتِيارِ الطّالِبِ المِثالِيِّ، وَيَذْكُرُ كُلُّ مُعَلِّمٍ صِفَةً. اِنْتَبِهْ إِلى أَنَّ الجائِزَةَ في النِّهايَةِ كُتُبٌ وَحَقيبَةٌ وَمَبْلَغٌ مِنَ المالِ.

dialogue.ar: اِجْتَمَعْنا اليَوْمَ لِنَخْتارَ الطّالِبَ المِثالِيَّ لِهَذا العامِ. ما الصِّفاتُ الَّتي تَرَوْنَها فيهِ؟
dialogue.tr: ijtamaʿnā l-yawma linakhtāra ṭ-ṭāliba l-mithāliyya lihadhā l-ʿām mā ṣ-ṣifātu llatī tarawnahā fīh?
dialogue.en: We have met today to choose the ideal student for this year. What qualities do you see in him?
dialogue.ur: Hum aaj is saal ke misali talib-e-ilm ko chunne ke liye jama hue hain. Aap us mein kaun si sifaat dekhte hain?

dialogue.ar: الطّالِبُ المِثالِيُّ عِنْدي هُوَ حَسَنُ الأَخْلاقِ، يُحافِظُ عَلى صَلَواتِهِ في وَقْتِها.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭālibu l-mithāliyyu ʿindī huwa ḥasanu l-akhlāq, yuḥāfiẓu ʿalā ṣalawtihi fī waqtihā
dialogue.en: To me the ideal student is the one of good manners, who keeps his prayers on time.
dialogue.ur: Mere nazdeek misali talib-e-ilm wo hai jo achhe akhlaq wala ho aur apni namazein waqt par ada kare.

dialogue.ar: وَهُوَ مَحْبوبٌ عِنْدَ الجَميعِ، يَهْتَمُّ بِنَظافَتِهِ وَمَظْهَرِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wahuwa maḥbūbun ʿinda l-jamīʿ, yahtammu binaẓāfatihi wamaẓharih
dialogue.en: And he is loved by everyone, and cares about his cleanliness and appearance.
dialogue.ur: Aur wo sab ka mehboob ho, aur apni safai aur zahiri halat ka khayal rakhta ho.

dialogue.ar: وَفي الدِّراسَةِ يَتَفَوَّقُ؛ فَنَتائِجُهُ في الاخْتِباراتِ مُمْتازَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: wafī d-dirāsati yatafawwaq fanatāʾijuhu fī l-khtibārāti mumtāza
dialogue.en: And in his studies he excels; his results in the exams are excellent.
dialogue.ur: Aur parhai mein wo aage hai; imtehanon mein uske nateeje shandar hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَشْتَرِكُ بِحَماسٍ في المُسابَقاتِ الثَّقافِيَّةِ، وَيُحِبُّ الكُتُبَ.
dialogue.tr: wayashtariku biḥamāsin fī l-musābaqāti th-thaqāfiya, wayuḥibbu al-kutub
dialogue.en: He takes part eagerly in the cultural competitions and loves books.
dialogue.ur: Wo josh se saqafati muqablon mein hissa leta hai aur kitabon se mohabbat rakhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلا يَنْسى الرِّياضَةَ، فَهُوَ نَشيطٌ في فَريقِ المَدْرَسَةِ وَأَنْشِطَتِها الرِّياضِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: walā yansā r-rīḍa, fahuwa nashīṭun fī farīqi l-madrasati waʾanshiṭatihā r-rīḍiya
dialogue.en: And he does not forget sport; he is active in the school team and its sports activities.
dialogue.ur: Aur wo khel ko nahin bhoolta, school ki team aur uski khel ki sargarmiyon mein sargarm hai.

dialogue.ar: لِيَكْتُبْ كُلُّ مُدَرِّسٍ في بِطاقَةٍ أَسْماءَ ثَلاثَةِ طُلّابٍ يَراهُمْ مُناسِبينَ.
dialogue.tr: liyaktub kullu mudarrisin fī biṭāqatin asmāʾa thalāthati ṭullābin yarāhum munāsibīn
dialogue.en: Let each teacher write on a card the names of three students he thinks are suitable.
dialogue.ur: Har ustaad ek card par teen aise talba ke naam likhe jo use munasib lagte hain.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ قَرَأْتُ البِطاقاتِ كُلَّها، فَوَجَدْتُ اسْماً واحِداً في كُلِّ بِطاقَةٍ: سامي بْنُ ماجِدٍ. هُوَ الطّالِبُ المِثالِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: laqad qaraʾtu l-biṭāqāti kullahā, fawajadtu sman wāḥidan fī kulli biṭāqa sāmī bnu mājid huwa ṭ-ṭālibu l-mithāliyy
dialogue.en: I have read all the cards and found one name on every card: Sami ibn Majid. He is the ideal student.
dialogue.ur: Maine saare card parh liye aur har card par ek hi naam paya: Sami bin Majid. Wahi misali talib-e-ilm hai.

dialogue.ar: سَنُخْبِرُ الطُّلّابَ بِالنَّتيجَةِ بَعْدَ أُسْبوعٍ، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: sanukhbiru ṭ-ṭulāba bin-natījati baʿda usbūʿ, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: We will tell the students the result after a week, God willing.
dialogue.ur: InshaAllah hum ek hafte baad talba ko nateeja bata denge.

dialogue.ar: وَتَتَضَمَّنُ الجائِزَةُ حَقيبَةً وَكُتُباً وَمَبْلَغاً مِنَ المالِ، وَسَيَحْضُرُ الحَفْلَ أَهالي الطُّلّابِ.
dialogue.tr: watataḍammanu l-jāʾizatu ḥaqībatan wakutuban wamablaghan mina l-māl, wasayaḥḍuru l-ḥafla ahālī ṭ-ṭulāb
dialogue.en: The prize includes a bag, books and a sum of money, and the students' families will attend the ceremony.
dialogue.ur: Inaam mein ek bag, kitabein aur kuch raqam shamil hai, aur talba ke gharane taqreeb mein shirkat karenge.

q.en: Who is chosen as the ideal student?
q.ur: Misali talib-e-ilm kaun chuna gaya?

q.en: What does the religion teacher want from the ideal student?
q.ur: Deen ka ustaad misali talib-e-ilm se kya chahta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يُريدُ مُعَلِّمُ الدِّينِ مِنَ الطّالِبِ المِثالِيِّ؟

options: To keep his prayers and have good manners
To get top marks in maths
options_ar: أَنْ يُحافِظَ عَلى صَلاتِهِ وَيَتَحَلّى بِالأَخْلاقِ
أَنْ يَنالَ أَعْلى الدَّرَجاتِ في الرِّياضِيّاتِ

q.en: How many students does each teacher choose for the card?
q.ur: Har ustaad card ke liye kitne talba chunta hai?
q.ar: كَمْ طالِباً يَخْتارُ كُلُّ مُعَلِّمٍ لِلْبِطاقَةِ؟

q.en: Which is part of the prize?
q.ur: Inaam mein kya shamil hai?

q.en: When will the result be announced?
q.ur: Nateeja kab bataya jayega?

title.en: Particles that put the present verb in nasb: «أَنْ» and «لَنْ»
title.ur: Mudaare' ko nasb dene walay huroof: «أَنْ» aur «لَنْ»

intro.en: After «أَنْ» (that, to) and «لَنْ» (will never) the present verb takes a fatha on its last letter. Example: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ الْمُسْلِمُ – the Muslim must perform wudu. And: لَنْ يَتْرُكَ الصَّلاةَ – he will never leave the prayer.
intro.ur: «أَنْ» (ke) aur «لَنْ» (hargiz nahin) ke baad mudaare' fe'l ke aakhir par zabar aata hai. Misal: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ الْمُسْلِمُ – musalman par wuzu karna wajib hai. Aur: لَنْ يَتْرُكَ الصَّلاةَ – woh namaz hargiz nahin chhodega.
intro.ar: بَعْدَ «أَنْ» وَ«لَنْ» يُنْصَبُ الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ فَيَأْخُذُ فَتْحَةً عَلى آخِرِهِ. مِثالٌ: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ المُسْلِمُ، وَلَنْ يَتْرُكَ الصَّلاةَ.

dialogue.ar: يَقولُ الطّالِبُ المُجْتَهِدُ: لَنْ أَنْسى واجِبي، وَلَنْ أُهْمِلَ صَلاتي، وَلَنْ يَشْغَلَني اللَّعِبُ عَنِ الدَّرْسِ.
dialogue.tr: yaqūlu ṭ-ṭālibu l-mujtahid lan ansā wājibī, walan uhmila ṣalātī, walan yashghalanī l-laʿibu ʿani d-dars
dialogue.en: The hard-working student says: I will never forget my homework, I will never neglect my prayer, and play will never keep me from the lesson.
dialogue.ur: Mehnati talib-e-ilm kehta hai: main apna kaam kabhi nahin bhoolunga, namaz ko kabhi nazarandaz nahin karunga, aur khel mujhe parhai se nahin rokega.

dialogue.ar: يُريدُ أَحْمَدُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاةِ، وَلَنْ يَتَأَخَّرَ عَنِ المَسْجِدِ.
dialogue.tr: yurīdu aḥmadu an yatawaḍḍaʾa qabla ṣ-ṣalā, walan yataʾakhkhara ʿani l-masjid
dialogue.en: Ahmad wants to make wudu before the prayer, and he will not be late for the mosque.
dialogue.ur: Ahmad namaz se pehle wuzu karna chahta hai, aur wo masjid pahunchne mein der nahin karega.

dialogue.ar: مَنِ اسْتَطاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَنْفَعَ أَخاهُ، فَلْيَنْفَعْهُ.
dialogue.tr: man istaṭāʿa minkum an yanfaʿa akhāh, fal-yanfaʿh
dialogue.en: Whoever among you is able to benefit his brother, let him benefit him.
dialogue.ur: Tum mein se jo apne bhai ko faida pohancha sake, woh pohancha de.

q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِلْفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ بَعْدَ «أَنْ» أَوْ «لَنْ»؟

options: It takes a fatha at the end (nasb)
It takes a damma at the end
It takes a kasra at the end

q.en: Which sentence is correct?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla durust hai?

q.ur: «يَجِبُ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ المُسْلِمُ» ka matlab:

intro.en: Listen to the text, then choose the correct answer for each question. The questions are about Bint al-Shati', an Arab woman writer and teacher who won prizes for her work. Try to understand the question words: كانَتْ (she was), حَصَلَتْ عَلى (she got), كَتَبَتْ (she wrote).
intro.ur: Matn sunein, phir har sawal ka sahi jawab chunein. Sawalat Bint al-Shati' ke baare mein hain, jo ek arab ustaani aur musannifa thin aur unhein apne kaam par inaamaat mile. Alfaz yaad karein: كانَتْ (woh thi), حَصَلَتْ عَلى (usay mila), كَتَبَتْ (usne likha).
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى النَّصِّ ثُمَّ اخْتَرِ الإِجابَةَ الصَّحيحَةَ. الأَسْئِلَةُ عَنْ بِنْتِ الشّاطِئِ، كاتِبَةٍ وَمُعَلِّمَةٍ عَرَبِيَّةٍ نالَتْ جَوائِزَ عَلى أَعْمالِها. تَعَرَّفْ عَلى الأَفْعالِ: كانَتْ، حَصَلَتْ عَلى، كَتَبَتْ.

vocab.en: the women of the Prophet's household

q.ur: «الشَّهادَةُ العامَّةُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.ur: In mein se kaun si taleemi manzil hai?

q.en: Which city is the capital of Egypt in this lesson?
q.ur: Is sabaq mein Misr ka kaun sa shehar aaya hai?
q.ar: ما عاصِمَةُ مِصْرَ في هَذا الدَّرْسِ؟

intro.en: A longer reading about the King Faisal International Prize: when it started, its five fields, what the winner receives, and some famous people who won it.
intro.ur: Shah Faisal aalami inaam ke baare mein ek lamba matn: yeh kab shuru hua, iske paanch shobay, jeetne wale ko kya milta hai, aur kuch mashhoor logon ke naam jinhon ne yeh inaam hasil kiya.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ أَطْوَلُ عَنْ جائِزَةِ المَلِكِ فَيْصَل العالَمِيَّةِ: مَتى بَدَأَتْ، وَمَجالاتُها الخَمْسَةُ، وَما يَنالُهُ الفائِزُ، وَبَعْضُ المَشاهيرِ الَّذينَ فازوا بِها.

dialogue.ar: تُقَدِّمُ مُؤَسَّسَةُ المَلِكِ فَيْصَلٍ الخَيْرِيَّةُ جائِزَةً عالَمِيَّةً كُلَّ عامٍ لِمَنْ يَخْدِمُ الإِنْسانِيَّةَ.
dialogue.tr: tuqaddimu muʾassasatu l-maliki fayṣalin al-khayriyyatu jāʾizatan ʿālamiyyatan kulla ʿāmin liman yakhdimu l-insāniyya
dialogue.en: The King Faisal Charitable Foundation gives an international prize every year to whoever serves humanity.
dialogue.ur: King Faisal Charitable Foundation har saal ek aalmi inaam us ko deta hai jo insaniyat ki khidmat kare.

dialogue.ar: وَهَذِهِ المَجالاتُ الخَمْسَةُ هِيَ: العُلومُ، وَالطِّبُّ، وَالأَدَبُ وَاللُّغَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ، وَالدِّراساتُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ، وَخِدْمَةُ الإِسْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: wahadhihi l-majālātu l-khamsatu hiy al-ʿulūm, waṭ-ṭib, wal-adabu wal-lughatu l-ʿarabiyya, wad-dirāsātu l-islāmiyya, wakhidmatu l-islām
dialogue.en: These five fields are: science, medicine, literature and the Arabic language, Islamic studies and service to Islam.
dialogue.ur: Ye paanch maidan hain: uloom, tibb, adab aur Arabi zubaan, Islami uloom aur khidmat-e-Islam.

dialogue.ar: يُسَلَّمُ الفائِزُ مَيْدالِيَّةً ذَهَبِيَّةً، وَشَهادَةً مَكْتوباً عَلَيْها اسْمُهُ، وَمُلَخَّصاً عَنْ إِنْجازِهِ، وَمَبْلَغاً مالِيّاً.
dialogue.tr: yusallamu l-fāʾizu maydāliyyatan dhahabiyya, washahādatan maktūban ʿalayhā smuh, wamulakhkhaṣan ʿan injāzih, wamablaghan māliyyan
dialogue.en: The winner is handed a gold medal, a certificate with his name written on it, a summary of his achievement and a sum of money.
dialogue.ur: Jeetne wale ko sone ka tamgha, uske naam ki sanad, uske karnamay ka khulasa aur kuch raqam di jati hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ فازَ بِها عُلَماءُ مِنَ الشَّرْقِ وَالغَرْبِ عَلى حَدٍّ سَواءٍ.
dialogue.tr: waqad fāza bihā ʿulamāʾu mina sh-sharqi wal-gharbi ʿalā ḥaddin sawʾ
dialogue.en: Scholars from the East and the West alike have won it.
dialogue.ur: Mashriq aur maghrib dono ke ulama ne ye inaam jeeta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالشَّيْخُ أَبو الأَعْلى المَوْدودِيُّ مِنْ باكِسْتانَ وَالشَّيْخُ أَبو الحَسَنِ النَّدْوِيُّ مِنَ الهِنْدِ مِمَّنْ نالَها في خِدْمَةِ الإِسْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: wash-shaykhu abū l-aʿlā l-mawdūdiyyu min bākistāna wash-shaykhu abū l-ḥasani n-nadwiyu mina l-hindi mimman nālahā fī khidmati l-islām
dialogue.en: From Pakistan Abul A'la Mawdudi received the prize for service to Islam, and from India Abul Hasan Nadwi.
dialogue.ur: Pakistan ke Abul A'la Maududi ko khidmat-e-Islam ka inaam mila, aur Hindustan ke Abul Hasan Nadwi ko bhi.

dialogue.ar: وَفي الدِّراساتِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ فازَ بِها فُؤادُ سِزْكينَ، وَهُوَ عالِمٌ تُرْكِيُّ الأَصْلِ.
dialogue.tr: wafī d-dirāsāti l-islāmiyyati fāza bihā fuʾādu sizkīn, wahuwa ʿālimun turkiyyu al-aṣl
dialogue.en: In Islamic studies it was won by Fuat Sezgin, a scholar of Turkish origin.
dialogue.ur: Islami uloom mein ye inaam Fuat Sezgin ne jeeta, jo Turk nasl ke aalim hain.

dialogue.ar: وَفي العُلومِ فازَ بِها أَحْمَدُ زُوَيْلٌ، وَهُوَ مِصْرِيُّ الأَصْلِ، وَمَوْلودٌ في مِصْرَ.
dialogue.tr: wafī l-ʿulūmi fāza bihā aḥmadu zuwayl, wahuwa miṣriyyu al-aṣl, wamawlūdun fī miṣr
dialogue.en: In science it was won by Ahmed Zewail, who is Egyptian by origin and was born in Egypt.
dialogue.ur: Uloom mein ye inaam Ahmed Zewail ne jeeta, jo asal mein Misri hain aur Misr mein paida hue.

dialogue.ar: وَتَهْدِفُ الجائِزَةُ إِلى تَشْجيعِ العُلَماءِ عَلى خِدْمَةِ الإِنْسانِيَّةِ في الشَّرْقِ وَالغَرْبِ.
dialogue.tr: watahdifu l-jāʾizatu ilā tashjīʿi l-ʿulamāʾi ʿalā khidmati l-insāniyyati fī sh-sharqi wal-gharb
dialogue.en: The prize aims to encourage scholars to serve humanity in the East and the West.
dialogue.ur: Is inaam ka maqsad ulama ko mashriq o maghrib mein insaniyat ki khidmat par ubharna hai.

intro.en: Pronouns can attach to the end of a verb to show who receives the action. Example: فَحَصَني الطَّبيبُ – the doctor examined me. Speaker: «ي / نا»; addressed: «ك / كِ / كما / كُم / كُنَّ»; absent: «هُ / ها / هما / هم / هُنَّ».
intro.ur: Zameerein fe'l ke aakhir mein judti hain aur batati hain ke kaam kis par hua. Misal: فَحَصَني الطَّبيبُ – doctor ne mujhe dekha. Mutakallim: «ي / نا»; mukhatab: «ك / كِ / كما / كُم / كُنَّ»; ghaib: «هُ / ها / هما / هم / هُنَّ».
intro.ar: يَتَّصِلُ الضَّميرُ بِآخِرِ الفِعْلِ لِيَدُلَّ عَلى مَنْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الفِعْلُ. مِثالٌ: فَحَصَني الطَّبيبُ. لِلْمُتَكَلِّمِ: ي، نا. لِلْمُخاطَبِ: ك، كِ، كُما، كُمْ، كُنَّ. لِلْغائِبِ: هُ، ها، هُما، هُمْ، هُنَّ.

intro.en: Copy the verse in naskh script: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذينَ قالوا رَبُّنَا اللهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقاموا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ المَلائِكَةُ أَلّا تَخافوا وَلا تَحْزَنوا﴾. Spelling rule: when «ال» comes before a word that starts with lam, we write both lams together without dropping any: اللَّيْلُ، اللُّغَةُ.
intro.ur: Aayat naskh khat mein naql karein: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذينَ قالوا رَبُّنَا اللهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقاموا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ المَلائِكَةُ أَلّا تَخافوا وَلا تَحْزَنوا﴾. Imla ka qaida: jab «ال» aisay lafz se pehle aaye jo lam se shuru ho to dono lam saath likhte hain, koi nahin girta: اللَّيْلُ، اللُّغَةُ.
intro.ar: اِنْسَخِ الآيَةَ بِخَطِّ النَّسْخِ: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذينَ قالوا رَبُّنَا اللهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقاموا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيْهِمُ المَلائِكَةُ أَلّا تَخافوا وَلا تَحْزَنوا﴾. قاعِدَةُ الإِمْلاءِ: إِذا دَخَلَتْ «ال» عَلى كَلِمَةٍ تَبْدَأُ بِلامٍ كَتَبْنا اللّامَيْنِ مَعاً دونَ حَذْفٍ: اللَّيْلُ، اللُّغَةُ.

intro.en: A review test that checks reading and grammar. The reading is about Amina, an Indonesian student in Medina who learned Arabic, memorised many parts of the Quran and now reads and speaks Arabic. Questions check understanding of the passage.
intro.ur: Dohrai ka imtehan jo parhne aur qawaid ko jaanchta hai. Parhna Amina ke baare mein hai, jo Indonesia ki talibah hai, Madina mein parhti hai, usne arabi seekhi, Quran ke bohat se hisse hifz kiye aur ab arabi parhti aur bolti hai. Sawalat matn ki samajh jaanchte hain.
intro.ar: اِخْتِبارٌ لِلْمُراجَعَةِ في القِراءَةِ وَالقَواعِدِ. النَّصُّ عَنْ أَمينَةَ، طالِبَةٍ إِنْدونيسِيَّةٍ في المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ تَعَلَّمَتِ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَحَفِظَتْ أَجْزاءً مِنَ القُرْآنِ وَصارَتْ تَقْرَأُ وَتَتَحَدَّثُ بِالعَرَبِيَّةِ. الأَسْئِلَةُ تَقيسُ فَهْمَكَ لِلنَّصِّ.

dialogue.ar: أَمينَةُ طالِبَةٌ إِنْدونيسِيَّةٌ، تَسْكُنُ في المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ وَتَدْرُسُ في الجامِعَةِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: amīnatu ṭālibatun indūnīsiyya, taskunu fī l-madīnati l-munawwarati watadrusu fī l-jāmiʿati l-islāmiyya
dialogue.en: Amina is an Indonesian student who lives in Medina and studies at the Islamic University.
dialogue.ur: Amina Indonesia ki talibah hai, Madina Munawwara mein rehti hai aur Islamic University mein parhti hai.

dialogue.ar: سافَرَتْ أَمينَةُ إِلى هُناكَ قَبْلَ أَرْبَعِ سَنَواتٍ لِتَتَعَلَّمَ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَتَدْرُسَ عُلومَ الدّينِ.
dialogue.tr: sāfarat amīnatu ilā hunāka qabla arbaʿi sanawtin litataʿallama l-ʿarabiyyata watadrusa ʿulūma d-dīn
dialogue.en: Amina travelled there four years ago to learn Arabic and study the religious sciences.
dialogue.ur: Amina chaar saal pehle wahan Arabi seekhne aur deeni uloom parhne gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَهِيَ الآنَ تَتَحَدَّثُ العَرَبِيَّةَ بِطَلاقَةٍ، وَتَحْفَظُ أَجْزاءً كَثيرَةً مِنَ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ.
dialogue.tr: wahiya l-ʾāna tataḥaddathu l-ʿarabiyyata biṭalāqa, wataḥfaẓu ajzāʾan kathīratan mina l-qurʾāni l-karīm
dialogue.en: She now speaks Arabic fluently and has memorised many parts of the Holy Quran.
dialogue.ur: Ab wo rawani se Arabi bolti hai aur Quran-e-Kareem ke bohat se hisse yaad kar chuki hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتَقْرَأُ الكُتُبَ العَرَبِيَّةَ، وَصَحيفَةً يَوْمِيَّةً، وَمَجَلَّةً أُسْبوعِيَّةً.
dialogue.tr: wataqraʾu l-kutuba l-ʿarabiyya, waṣaḥīfatan yawmiyya, wamajallatan usbūʿiyya
dialogue.en: She reads Arabic books, a daily newspaper and a weekly magazine.
dialogue.ur: Wo Arabi kitabein, ek roznama aur ek haftawar risala parhti hai.

dialogue.ar: تَقولُ أَمينَةُ: العَرَبِيَّةُ سَهْلَةٌ إِذا دَرَسْناها بِصَبْرٍ، وَيَسْتَخْدِمُها أَكْثَرُ مِنْ مِلْيارِ مُسْلِمٍ في عِباداتِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: taqūlu amīna al-ʿarabiyyatu sahlatun idhā darasnāhā biṣabr, wayastakhdimuhā aktharu min milyri muslimin fī ʿibādātihim
dialogue.en: Amina says: Arabic is easy if we study it patiently, and more than a billion Muslims use it in their worship.
dialogue.ur: Amina kehti hai: agar sabr se parhein to Arabi aasaan hai, aur ek arab se zyada musalman apni ibadat mein use istemal karte hain.

intro.en: A midterm review of Units 1 to 8: reading comprehension, true or false, grammar, vocabulary and arranging words into sentences. The passage tells how Muslims carried Arabic-Islamic civilisation and science to Europe.
intro.ur: Unit 1 se 8 ki nisf-e-sal dohrai: parhna aur samajhna, sahi ya galat, qawaid, alfaz aur lafzon se jumle banana. Matn bayan karta hai ke musalmanon ne arabi-islami tehzeeb aur uloom Europe tak kaise pohanchaye.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلْوَحَداتِ مِنَ الأولى إِلى الثّامِنَةِ: فَهْمُ المَقْروءِ، وَالصَّوابُ وَالخَطَأُ، وَالقَواعِدُ، وَالمُفْرَداتُ، وَتَرْتيبُ الكَلِماتِ في جُمَلٍ. يَحْكي النَّصُّ كَيْفَ نَقَلَ المُسْلِمونَ الحَضارَةَ وَالعُلومَ إِلى أُوروبّا.

dialogue.ar: قَبْلَ قُرونٍ طَويلَةٍ انْتَشَرَتِ الحَضارَةُ الإِسْلامِيَّةُ في أَرْجاءٍ واسِعَةٍ مِنَ العالَمِ.
dialogue.tr: qabla qurūnin ṭawīlatin ntasharati l-ḥaḍāratu l-islāmiyyatu fī arjāʾin wāsiʿatin mina l-ʿālam
dialogue.en: Many centuries ago the Islamic civilisation spread across wide regions of the world.
dialogue.ur: Kai sadiyon pehle Islami tehzeeb duniya ke wasee ilaqon mein phail gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَفي أُوروبّا بَقِيَتْ لَها آثارٌ ظاهِرَةٌ في إِسْبانيا وَإِيطالْيا وَفَرَنْسا.
dialogue.tr: wafī ūrūbbā baqiyat lahā ʾāthārun ẓāhiratun fī isbānī waʾīṭāly wafaransā
dialogue.en: In Europe visible traces of it remained in Spain, Italy and France.
dialogue.ur: Europe mein Spain, Italy aur France mein uske wazeh aasaar baaqi rahe.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ بَغْدادُ وَقُرْطُبَةُ مَدينَتَيْنِ لِلْعِلْمِ، وَفيهِما مَعاهِدُ وَمَكْتَباتٌ كَثيرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: kānat baghdādu waqurṭubatu madīnatayni lil-ʿilm, wafīhimā maʿāhidu wamaktabātun kathīra
dialogue.en: Baghdad and Cordoba were cities of knowledge, with many institutes and libraries.
dialogue.ur: Baghdad aur Qurtuba ilm ke shehar the, jin mein bohat se idare aur kutub-khane the.

dialogue.ar: وَجاءَ إِلَيْهِما طُلّابٌ مِنْ بِلادٍ أُوروبِّيَّةٍ لِيَتَعَلَّموا الطِّبَّ وَالرِّياضِيّاتِ وَالفَلَكَ وَالهَنْدَسَةَ.
dialogue.tr: wajāʾa ilayhimā ṭullābun min bilādin ūrūbbiyyatin liyataʿallamū ṭ-ṭiba war-rīḍiyāti wal-falaka wal-handasa
dialogue.en: Students from European countries came to them to learn medicine, mathematics, astronomy and engineering.
dialogue.ur: Europe ke mulkon se talba wahan tibb, riyazi, falkiyat aur handasa seekhne aate the.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ رَجَعوا إِلى بِلادِهِمْ يَحْمِلونَ الكُتُبَ وَالمَعارِفَ، فَكانَ ذَلِكَ بِدايَةً لِنَهْضَةٍ عِلْمِيَّةٍ جَديدَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: thumma rajaʿū ilā bilādihim yaḥmilūna l-kutuba wal-maʿārif, fakāna dhālika bidāyatan linahḍatin ʿilmiyyatin jadīda
dialogue.en: Then they returned to their countries carrying books and knowledge, and that was the beginning of a new scientific revival.
dialogue.ur: Phir wo kitabein aur ilm le kar apne mulkon ko lautay, aur ye ek naye ilmi ehya ki shuruaat thi.

q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq musalmanon ne arabi-islami tehzeeb duniya ke kis hisse tak pohanchai?
q.ar: إِلى أَيِّ جُزْءٍ مِنَ العالَمِ نَقَلَ المُسْلِمونَ الحَضارَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ الإِسْلامِيَّةَ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.ur: Europe le jaye gaye uloom mein se kaun sa matn mein hai?

q.en: Put the words in order: «العَمَلُ – نِعْمَةٌ – مِنْ – نِعَمِ – اللهِ»
q.ur: Alfaz ko tarteeb dein: «العَمَلُ – نِعْمَةٌ – مِنْ – نِعَمِ – اللهِ»
q.ar: رَتِّبِ الكَلِماتِ في جُمْلَةٍ: «العَمَلُ – نِعْمَةٌ – مِنْ – نِعَمِ – اللهِ»
